searchText: annoncement will be made in this channel right <@!364458974906548225> https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/09/06/core-dev-apprenticeship-second-cohort/ It is now 😉 FYI, if you applied during the first cohort and did not get in, and you want to be considered for the second cohort, you will need to apply again. Hey <@!364458974906548225> , can I DM you regarding a few questions on CDAP? I am planning to apply for the second cohort I encourage you to ask any questions here on this channel that don't have a specific reason to be kept private. Anything that doesn't fit that is fine to ask in DM I wanted to understand what opportunities open up once a person is successfully able deliver the project during the program? One obvious thing is : The person is able to generate massive Proof of Work. I hope this helps that person to land a full time job with the teams ? Are there other things as well ? Some context : I am currently a Backend dev and planning to switch into Blockchain space. To get a taste of how it would be like : I am currently working as a part time in a project in Polkadot ecosystem. Please forgive me if this comes out rude. I do not mean it to be that way. I am just trying to gather as much info I can. In super frank terms, I am trying to figure out answer to this . Part-time in Polkadot --> Full time in Polkadot --> Eventually start something of my own VS CDAP --> (What opportunities/learnings are possible here) --> Eventually start something of my own <@385832319312986112> have you looked through the development updates and notes from the first cohort? That should give you some context for what CDAP involves eth Spot on. The demonstration of your ability to do the work is one of the intended results. I can't make guarantees about getting you a job but I'll open all the doors I can.
